profile_text.body:
Runway is a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, NY. On its own site the company describes itself as building foundational Real-World Intelligence that can understand, simulate and act in the world, with products and services built on top of that intelligence for individuals and organizations. Its tracked product is listed under video generation and editing, and the site points to enterprise video generation as a current focus, citing themes such as data sovereignty, cost economics, autonomous execution and model ownership drawn from enterprise conversations.

The site states that its components, from policy inference and evaluation to synthetic data generation, are powered by GWM-1, which it calls a state-of-the-art General World Model and a step toward universal simulation. It also describes Solaris as its first Interface World Model, real-time AI that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame without code. Runway advertises an AI Summit on 9/30 in San Francisco, with speakers from DeepMind, NVIDIA and Physical Intelligence.

The company's litigation record includes several cases: David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. in the District Court for the Southern District of New York and in the Central District of California, Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc. and Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc, both in the Southern District of New York, and Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. Its recorded law exposure is in New York, with a count of 424.
